Definition: from G4060; a putting all around, i.e. decorating oneself with:--wearing.
BiblicalUsage: Perithesis is a putting on, an adorning — the wearing of gold and the putting on of apparel. Peter says the adorning of a godly wife is not to be the outward adorning of plaited hair and gold and fine clothes.
TheologicalSignificance: What I believe is that the adorning God sees is not the one the world sees: gold and apparel pass, and the hidden man of the heart remains.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
